top_story.headline: Rep. Dan Crenshaw still has no 2025 annual financial disclosure on file, 68 days past his final extension
top_story.dek: The House member's last extension expired August 13, and no report appears in the Clerk of the House index or Senate eFD.
paragraphs: Rep. Dan Crenshaw (R-TX-2) filed an extension on June 4, 2026. The final extension date was August 13, 2026, so as of today the calendar-year 2025 annual report is 68 days overdue. The Deadline Watch check compares every sitting member against the Clerk of the House index and Senate eFD, and Crenshaw is the only sitting member it found with no report on file past every extension. The script warns that a filing under an unexpected spelling of a name can read as missing.

Separately, the Ethics Agreement Tracker lists 7 confirmed officials with no posted certification of ethics-agreement compliance more than 30 days after the deadline. They include Michelle White Bowman, Governor and Vice Chairman for Supervision of the Federal Reserve System Board of Governors (certification due September 2, 2025, 413 days ago), and Andrea R. Lucas, Commissioner of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (due October 29, 2025, 356 days ago). The tracker also logged a new conflict-of-interest waiver for Jennifer Shuford at the Department of Health and Human Services, posted October 20; OGE does not post the text of the waiver.

Today's other notable item is a FARA Exhibit AB from Dickens & Madson Canada Inc.. Its OCR text refers to President Donald Trump, but the excerpt does not state a date or method, so it is reported below as filed.

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: One FARA filing refers to a Cairo meeting with President Donald Trump; one lobbying report names the Vice President's office
paragraphs: One FARA filing carries text that refers to the President, and its excerpt does not give a date or method. One LDA report lists the Office of the Vice President as an entity lobbied. No texts or calls were logged in today's block.

items: President Donald Trump: Dickens & Madson Canada Inc. (registrant #6200) filed an Exhibit AB, stamped October 16, 2026, for its foreign principal Dr. Abdulelah Bin Khaled Allam (Saudi Arabia). The OCR'd text reads "capacity as candidate for the Head of the Governing Council of / Gaza with President Donald Trump and President Abdel / Fattah al- Sisi of the Arab Republic of Egypt in Cairo this month." The method of contact is not stated, no date is given, and the fragment does not say whether a meeting has taken place. Filing.

Office of the Vice President (LDA): 60 Plus Association (self-filed, 3rd Quarter report) lists the Office of the Vice President among the entities lobbied and names Howard Lutnick and Jamieson Greer. The activities listed are signing coalition letters urging Members of Congress to support the bipartisan Identifying Regulatory Barriers to Housing Supply Act and to expand Health Savings Accounts in reconciliation. Filing.

sections.headline: A Washington law firm registers for a Barbados company's arbitration dispute with Indonesia
paragraphs: One new registrant, with its Exhibit AB and registration statement, plus one amendment to a short-form fee arrangement. No terminations or dropped foreign principals appear in today's items.

items: New registrant: Wiss & Partners LLP (#7781), registered October 18, 2026, for foreign principal Detente Corporation (Barbados). Registration.

Exhibit AB (filing): Detente is a corporation described as a "distribution and services center; project manager." The filing answers No to every question on supervision, ownership, direction, control, financing and subsidy by a foreign government or party. The excerpt shown does not include contract dates or fees.

Registration statement (filing): the firm was organized November 21, 2016 in the District of Columbia and is 100% owned by its managing partner, Marcia Ann Wiss. She and Fadia Tuma Antunes represented Detente as legal counsel in an arbitral action against the Government of Indonesia. Lorin S. Weisenfeld assists the firm in negotiating with the Government of Indonesia about paying the international arbitral award against it.

Amendment: Piro, Inc. (#7732) updated Item 14 of the short-form registration of agent Doron Storfer, stamped October 19, 2026. He will receive a total fixed fee of $14,000, payable in two $7,000 installments. This replaces the earlier arrangement of a $10,000 flat fee plus up to $10,000 for approved overages. Filing.

blocks.text: Tracking 483 Senate-confirmed officials with ethics agreements since Jan. 20, 2025. Deadlines are counted from the confirmation date on congress.gov plus the agreement's stated window (usually 90 days) -- OGE can grant extensions that aren't public, so treat each flag as a lead to confirm, not a finding. OGE posts certifications with a lag, so nothing inside 30 days of a deadline is flagged. A certification filed but not yet posted by OGE will read as missing: confirm with the agency before publishing.
